title: The Scratch on the Bench
youtube_title: The Scratch on the Bench | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Brisa is tangled up with a fresh scratch on the bench from a dragged bucket and almost hides it. Brisa tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
